title: Make the provisioned Linux Vulkan SDK glslang include lookup case-tolerant
body: Fresh gpuyield configure: cmake --preset vixen-wsl -S VIXEN -B build/gpuyield -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy printed Fatal Error: glslang directory not found at x86_64/Include/glslang although provisioning supplies x86_64/include/glslang. Recovery uses the documented worktree-local ln -s include VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk/1.4.350.1/x86_64/Include and reconfigures through the live queue. Resolve the actual SDK include directory in provisioning/finder rather than requiring manual casing aliases.

title: Size VIXEN queued build credits from the requested compiler parallelism
body: gpuyield-baseline-apps-checks requested resource build with cmake --build build/gpuyield --parallel 4 and stayed queued for more than twelve minutes needing three CPU tokens, with only one available. The owned waiting wrapper was cancelled before any target ran (exit 143, inconclusive baseline). The documented recovery --resource build --credits 1 with --parallel 2 admitted immediately and is compiling fresh targets under the live queue and its unchanged memory gate. Derive the admission request from explicit build parallelism, or publish a supported low-footprint VIXEN entry point, instead of requiring a manual credits override.

title: Derive compute pipeline dispatch-base capability from bounded command recording
body: R477 tiles use vkCmdDispatchBase, but ComputePipelineCacher has no declared dispatch capability to derive VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_DISPATCH_BASE_BIT. This lane must add the flag manually to every cached compute pipeline. Consolidate pipeline capability derivation with graph command requirements; preserve compatible cached pipelines without a parallel registry.

title: Preserve compute builtin dependencies in the existing shader reflection contract
body: R477 must perform a separate SPIRV-Reflect module inspection to avoid changing gl_NumWorkGroups in generic compute shaders. Existing SpirvReflectionData/cache metadata discards this dependency, so dispatch code cannot derive tile eligibility from its ordinary bundle metadata. Consolidate consumed builtin IDs into the existing reflection result and cache format, then derive dispatch/pipeline capability from that result.

title: Make zero-count Vulkan submit payload copies safe without pointer arithmetic
body: The existing SubmitRecord adapter formed pointer+0 ranges even when Vulkan permits a null array pointer with count zero. The new semaphore-only completion test required manual guards for every optional array. Consolidate zero-count handling in the existing native payload adapter conventions so producers do not need caller-side fake storage.
